newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 30.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Henri Konan Bedie preaches national unity at first conference of Moslem imams of Ivory Coast at the weekend

- Ivorians and other nationals of countries belonging to the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) will soon need travel document to circulate in the region; decision on date for issuing the Ivorian document has yet to be announced
- Secondary school teachers union SYNESCI angry with government over lack of progress on grievances over pay and working conditions; calls for new social contract for teachers
- Ivorian imams elect El Hadj Sanogo, imam from Abidjan's populous Adjame district, as their spiritual leader.
